result.title: RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
result.summary: Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace diagnosis. On natural failures from TraceElephant and CatchBench POST, it outperforms these baselines and three open LLMs in localization.

AI.brief_summary: RecordRoute 研究失败 agent 执行轨迹的审计，用词级与字符级特征在单条轨迹内做比较式排序，定位责任角色与最早决定性步骤，再以选中记录的文本和元数据预测错误模式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其步骤级定位与「先定位、再基于该步做诊断」的耦合思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹中的贡献分配、证据筛选与停止位置判断提供借鉴，但对象是纯文本 agent 日志、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移性有待核查。
